channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Brandon Ingram | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Brandon Ingram from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Bobby Webster on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Bobby Webster on Brandon Ingram’s fit in his first season with Toronto, and if he sees BI as a long-term fit with this group:

“By all accounts, I think Brandon fit in, and I think now this is the time for him to continue to improve shooting, get bigger, get stronger.”

Bobby Webster on Brandon Ingram, May 6, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on Free throws, Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Darko Rajakovic:

“Their whole team is very very physical with Brandon. So for me it's very interesting that he had 0 free throws in this game. Seeing zero takes, zero makes, it's interesting”

Darko Rajakovic on Free throws, Brandon Ingram, Apr 20, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
JoshLewenberg: Darko Rajakovic:

“We had a long day yesterday watching film, long meetings this morning, great conversations today. So, we’re going to have some solutions and try to adjust. But, definitely, we’ve gotta involve Brandon (Ingram) much more in our offence and we have a plan to do so.”

Darko Rajakovic on Brandon Ingram, Apr 19, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Jamal Shead on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Jamal Shead on Brandon Ingram:

“We watched a lot of film. We looked at how they were guarding him and how we could attack it. So that won’t happen again. BI has to get the ball in his hands. He’s the No. 1 option on our team. He has to have more than 9 shots.”

Jamal Shead on Brandon Ingram, Apr 19, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Darko Rajakovic on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Darko Rajakovic on Brandon Ingram attempting only 9 shots, including just 1 in the 2nd half:

“I’m not satisfied with that at all. We’ve gotta do a better job of executing, freeing him up and playing to our standards of ball movement… Some of that is on me, but we as a group have to do better”

Darko Rajakovic on Brandon Ingram, Apr 18, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Steve Kerr on coaching Brandon Ingram with Team USA in 2023:

“He was a great guy to coach. Very quiet but determined player and skilled. I was happy for him to be traded (to Toronto). It seems like he’s really taken to the role here and he’s playing well.”

Steve Kerr on Brandon Ingram, Dec 28, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: JJ Redick on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
JJ Redick on his former Pelicans teammate Brandon Ingram:

“He’s a student of the game. His approach to his craft is 10 out of 10. It looks like, at least on film, that he’s in that comfort zone of playing in the mid range…BI’s ability to read the game is at a really high level”

JJ Redick on Brandon Ingram, Dec 4, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rich Paul on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
[SiriusXM NBA Radio] Rich Paul:

“Having him (Brandon Ingram) traded from New Orleans and then doing his deal during the season with the Raptors... He is making 40 million dollars a year for the next 3 years that probably wouldn't be there for him if we get to quote-unquote free agency.”

Rich Paul on Brandon Ingram, Jul 23, 2025. Source: reddit.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Masai Ujiri:

“Trading for Brandon Ingram and then signing him, extending him, I think, just a tiny little bit, this kind of helps us head towards our goal, growing to be a championship team. Championship is the goal, the end goal.”

Masai Ujiri on Brandon Ingram, Apr 16, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Toronto Raptors President Masai Ujiri on Brandon Ingram:

“We see Brandon as an integral part of this team's future. He's an elite scorer, he has a really diverse offensive skillset, and adding him to the young core we have is huge as we continue our quest to win in Toronto.”

Masai Ujiri on Brandon Ingram, Feb 6, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jose Alvarado on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Jose Alvarado on Brandon Ingram's performance in training camp:

“He looks more comfortable, and (his shot is) going in. He’s shooting threes on fast breaks, being B.I., but expanding his game to the three-point line.”

Jose Alvarado on Brandon Ingram, Oct 4, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Zion Williamson on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
“(I want to) learn from (Brandon Ingram). Learn from CJ (McCollum). Learn from guys who have been in the league longer than me. Paying attention to their professionalism,”

Zion Williamson on Brandon Ingram, Sep 26, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: David Griffin on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
David Griffin:

“Brandon (Ingram) wants to stay here. He believes in what we're building. That's meaningful to us.... At the same time, there's a financial reality that we all deal with. We're excited about Brandon. We know he's excited about us.”

David Griffin on Brandon Ingram, Jun 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @WillGuillory.

item.title: Luguentz Dort on CJ McCollum, Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Lu Dort on guarding Brandon Ingram & CJ McCollum:

“This is what I’ve dreamed for. I’ve been doing this my whole career now. Just having different matchups.”

Luguentz Dort on CJ McCollum, Brandon Ingram, Apr 22, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Brandon Ingram, Luguentz Dort
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Lu Dort’s defense on Brandon Ingram:

“He was on it. He was really on it. Really disruptive. I thought Dub did a really great job on Ingram. Thought Kenrich did a great job on Ingram. Wallace did a great job on McCollum.”

Mark Daigneault on Brandon Ingram, Luguentz Dort, Apr 22, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Willie Green on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Willie Green on not closing with Brandon Ingram:

“I just liked the group that was on the floor at the time. B.I. is still getting back. Still getting his rhythm. So I didn’t want to force the issue. I liked the group that was going.”

Willie Green on Brandon Ingram, Apr 16, 2024. Source: Twitter @cclark_13.

item.title: Willie Green on Brandon Ingram, Jose Alvarado
item.description:
Jose Alvarado’s absence over the last three due to an oblique strain has also drained some of the juice out of the team.

“The resiliency is at a high level, but our margin for error is small without (Ingram) and without (Alvarado),”

Willie Green on Brandon Ingram, Jose Alvarado, Apr 2, 2024. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Trey Murphy on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Christian Clark:Trey Murphy on Brandon Ingram:

“He’s made humungous steps defensively. It’s a tribute to how much he wants to win. His first two years, I felt like there were times when he was really focused on offense. This year, he’s been locked in defensively.”

Trey Murphy on Brandon Ingram, Mar 14, 2024. Source: Twitter @cclark_13.

item.title: Bilal Coulibaly on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Bilal Coulibaly:

“With Brandon Ingram, I was playing great defense. But he was just getting his shots. It was tough mentally (laughs). It was tough. I was like, ‘What can I do better?’He had fadeaways. He was getting that mid-range. I was contesting as much as possible. But he’s taller than me and longer than me. He was getting those shots up.”

Bilal Coulibaly on Brandon Ingram, Mar 2, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Willie Green on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
“Oh for sure. There ARE some similarities with AI and BI. Number one, they have a knack for scoring in all different kinds of ways -- they can shoot the ball, they can attack the basket, they can score in the midrange,they can get to the free throw line and with B.I., it’s funny you say that because Allen was one of his favorite players growing up. So, you can see some similarities there; obviously AI is a Hall of Famer, but Brandon is an INCREDIBLE scorer; he can give you buckets like you said in a ton of different ways. It was really fun to watch tonight, just beautiful basketball by our team.”

Willie Green on Brandon Ingram, Dec 14, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Will Hardy on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
“I think his effort kind of rubs off on everybody. He's flying around out there. I'm really happy for him. I don't think coming into this season he saw himself as somebody that would guard a Brandon Ingram, but he's showing us every day that he's capable of giving us more.”

Will Hardy on Brandon Ingram, Nov 28, 2023. Source: KSL.com.

item.title: Mikal Bridges on Brandon Ingram, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
“I mean, like me and Jaren (Jackson) have been close, being drafted (in the same class).Me and Ant (Anthony Edwards) always talk to each other in games. Me and BI (Ingram), just because of Josh and stuff. So, it’s all falling together, and it’s great.”

Mikal Bridges on Brandon Ingram, Anthony Edwards, Aug 14, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Austin Reaves on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Reaves, when asked by Yahoo Sports reporter Vincent Goodwill who he's most excited to play with on Team USA, singled out Ingram due to his physical attributes and play style.

“I think Brandon Ingram is someone that's just like, I don’t even know how tall he is, arms long as s*** and just gets to his spot and [is] never rushed,”

Austin Reaves on Brandon Ingram, Aug 7, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Brandon Ingram, Anthony Edwards, Tyrese Haliburton, Austin Reaves
item.description:
“When you have good passers, teams connect quickly. … Brandon Ingram made about four drive-and-kicks yesterday that were incredible plays, leading to wide-open shots. Anthony Edwards has really been moving the ball. And some of these guys have it come so naturally to them, Tyrese (Haliburton), Austin Reaves – these guys are great passers. Jalen from the point guard spot. Mikal as well, and you start adding in the bigs. They’re all of a sudden out of a short roll. We’re getting swings to the perimeter. The whole group is connected and it’s really fun to watch.”

Steve Kerr on Brandon Ingram, Anthony Edwards, Tyrese Haliburton, Austin Reaves, Aug 5, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Larry Nance Jr on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Larry Nance Jr. on Brandon Ingram:

“His playmaking has come leaps and bounds. He's gained more of that presence, being able to see our shooters when they pop open,throwing those crosscourt passes.”

Larry Nance Jr on Brandon Ingram, Apr 3, 2023. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Draymond Green on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
“The thing that people don’t realize is when you make decisions like that — so some people who don’t understand winning… would say, ‘But Brandon Ingram has been an All-Star, so that was the wrong move,’”

Draymond Green on Brandon Ingram, Aug 10, 2022. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Larry Nance Jr on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Christian Clark:Larry Nance Jr. on Brandon Ingram:

“If his career is an elevator, this is not the top floor. Kid is incredible.”

Larry Nance Jr on Brandon Ingram, Apr 29, 2022. Source: Twitter @cclark_13.

item.title: Devonte Graham on CJ McCollum, Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Devonte' Graham on #Pelicans:

“(Ingram) takes and makes difficult shots for us. When we don’t have anything going, he takes a lot of pressure off us by knocking those shots down. When you’ve got an All-Star like that, him and CJ (McCollum) not in the game, it’s a huge adjustment”

Devonte Graham on CJ McCollum, Brandon Ingram, Mar 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Willie Green on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Willie Green on Brandon Ingram:

“He's definitely an All-Star. No doubt about it. ... He's one of the best players in the NBA, in my opinion.”

Willie Green on Brandon Ingram, Jan 7, 2022. Source: Twitter @WillGuillory.

item.title: Willie Green on Brandon Ingram
item.description:
Christian Clark:Willie Green on Brandon Ingram:

“When he’s just making the simple plays and getting in the paint and finding his teammates, our team just plays with joy and finds a renewed energy. It’s what we rely on him to do, and he has been doing a great job of it.”

Willie Green on Brandon Ingram, Dec 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @cclark_13.
